title: Why Voltaire Labs founder Fabrice Le Parc chose Every over Stripe Atlas and Firstbase
summary: Voltaire Labs founder Fabrice Le Parc explains why he chose Every to incorporate his U.S. startup and what he wanted from a back office.
body_markdown:
## Key takeaways


- As a French founder incorporating a U.S. startup, Fabrice Le Parc wanted more than a quick company formation. He wanted one place to handle the back office—and a team he could actually talk to.
- After using Stripe Atlas and Firstbase for previous ventures, Fabrice chose Every for its back-office tools and responsive team.
- He’s building Voltaire Labs, an AI lab developing Volt, a model intended to help operate and grow businesses.


## Why did you choose Every?


**Fabrice Le Parc:** So I chose every when I want to incorporate because as a French founder building a US company, I want a whole back office in one place. So incorporation, bank. treasury, taxes, etc.


## What alternatives did you consider?


**Fabrice Le Parc:** So I did consider other incorporation platforms like Stripe Atlas, Firstbase that I used in the past for our ventures. But I felt that I actually had a human relationship with the team at Every. I feel like everyone was super reactive, super proactive as well.


## What other Every products do you expect to use?


**Fabrice Le Parc:** So out of all the services that Every provides, I'm thinking of using pretty much everything you provide from payroll to, well, banking, obviously, payroll, bookkeeping, tax management.


## Tell us about Voltaire Labs.


**Fabrice Le Parc:** I launched Voltaire Labs, a small AI lab that develops Volt, a new company model. So it's actually a new class of model that can operate and grow a business.
